# PHPMailer (vendored)

- Version: **7.1.1** (released 2026-05-18), from https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/releases/tag/v7.1.1
- Files: `src/PHPMailer.php`, `src/SMTP.php`, `src/Exception.php`, copied unchanged, plus `LICENSE` (LGPL 2.1) and `VERSION`.
- Loaded by `server/bootstrap.php` (namespace `PHPMailer\PHPMailer\` → `vendor/phpmailer/src/`). There's no Composer on the server.
- To update: download the new release, replace these three files and `VERSION`, and update this note.
